title: Did not work
text: Did not work. Great invention for a single cup I loved it that you could grind coffee but it only worked for one week, it started making only 1/2 of a cup but I wondered where the water went, it dripped so slow that it took 10 minutes to make make 1/2 cup and the water went some place. But if they fix it, this machine is easy and a great idea. Fresh ground coffee taste 10 better than coffee pods. This machine also took ground coffee, but I never used it, but the pods did not work either. I would buy it again if the get the bugs out of it.
